name: Mark Baker
education: A.S. and A.A., Western Wyoming Community College; B.A., University of Wyoming; graduate, Wyoming Real Estate, Inc. (2021–22 legislative directory)
prior_offices: Wyoming House District 60, 2013–2022 (the 2021–22 directory said he had previously served five years in the House and had been reelected for 2021–2022)
background: Mark Baker of Green River served in the Wyoming House, including House District 60 in 2021–2022. The official historical directory lists House service from 2013 to 2022. The 2021–22 legislative directory said he was born in Pocatello, Idaho; listed associate degrees from Western Wyoming Community College, a B.A. from the University of Wyoming, and a Wyoming Real Estate, Inc. graduate credential; and identified him as a business owner and realtor. It said he was married to his wife, Amanda Potts-Baker, and had two children.
